pr_title: fix: differentiate rate limits for authenticated and anonymous clients (#200)
pr_body:
This PR modifies ratelimit.py to apply separate rate limits for authenticated and anonymous clients, resolving issue #200.

Changes:
- Added detection of authenticated users via request.state.user (set by auth middleware), falling back to IP for anonymous.
- Separate in-memory counters for authenticated (_auth_request_counts) and anonymous (_anon_request_counts) clients.
- Separate rate limit configurations (config_auth and config_anon) that default to the original config if not provided.
- The middleware still excludes the /health path.
- Response headers now include X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit, and X-RateLimit-Auth (indicating if the client was authenticated).

Closes #200
